blocks.zh: Structure and Terminology — 結構與術語
blocks.en: Structure and Terminology

blocks.zh: 解讀：術語變革的意義
blocks.en: Commentary: What the Terminology Changes Mean

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISO 9001 要改術語？
blocks.en: Why did ISO 9001 change its terminology?

blocks.zh: 2015 版最大的幕後動機是「高階結構（High Level Structure, HLS）」的採用。ISO 決策：所有管理系統標準（QMS、EMS、OHSMS 等）共用相同的條款骨架，讓企業可以輕鬆整合多個管理系統。術語統一是第一步。
blocks.en: The biggest driver behind the 2015 edition was the adoption of the High Level Structure (HLS). ISO decided that all management system standards (QMS, EMS, OHSMS and so on) would share the same clause framework, so that companies can easily integrate several management systems. Harmonizing terminology is the first step.

blocks.zh: 比喻：電源插頭的標準化
blocks.en: Analogy: standardizing the power plug

blocks.zh: 以前各國插頭規格不同，每次出國要帶轉接頭。HLS 就是 ISO 管理系統的「通用插頭」——不管你同時跑 ISO 9001（品質）、ISO 14001（環境）還是 ISO 45001（安全），條款編號和術語對齊，讓你只需維護一套系統。
blocks.en: Plug specifications used to differ from country to country, and you needed an adapter every time you travelled abroad. The HLS is the "universal plug" of ISO management systems: whether you run ISO 9001 (quality), ISO 14001 (environment) or ISO 45001 (safety) at the same time, the clause numbers and terminology are aligned, so you only need to maintain one system.

blocks.zh: 製藥業實務：術語映射
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical practice: terminology mapping

blocks.zh: ISO 9001:2015 明確指出，組織不必把內部文件裡的「SOP」改叫「documented information」，也不必把「supplier」改叫「external provider」。這對已建立龐大文件系統的製藥廠是一大解脫。
blocks.en: ISO 9001:2015 states explicitly that an organization does not have to rename "SOP" in its internal documents as "documented information", nor rename "supplier" as "external provider". This is a great relief for pharmaceutical plants that have already built a large documentation system.

blocks.zh: 實務做法：在 QMS 手冊的術語對照表中說明公司用語與 ISO 2015 用語的對應即可。審計員接受這種做法。
blocks.en: Practical approach: simply explain in the terminology mapping table of the QMS manual how the company's terms correspond to the ISO 2015 terms. Auditors accept this approach.

blocks.zh: 「Quality Manual 不再必要」的影響
blocks.en: The impact of "the Quality Manual is no longer required"

blocks.zh: 2008 版要求必須有品質手冊（Quality Manual）。2015 版取消此要求，改為彈性的「documented information」。但在 GMP 管制產業（製藥、醫療器材），監管機構（FDA、EMA）通常仍期望看到某種形式的品質手冊或等效文件作為系統概覽。
blocks.en: The 2008 edition required a Quality Manual. The 2015 edition removed this requirement in favour of flexible "documented information". However, in GMP-regulated industries (pharmaceuticals, medical devices), regulators (FDA, EMA) usually still expect to see some form of quality manual or equivalent document as an overview of the system.

blocks.zh: Products and Services — 產品與服務
blocks.en: Products and Services

blocks.zh: 解讀：服務被明確納入的含義
blocks.en: Commentary: What Explicitly Including Services Means

blocks.zh: 核心差異：服務的「現場性」
blocks.en: The core difference: the "real-time" nature of services

blocks.zh: 製造業生產完成品，可以在交付前進行檢驗確認。服務業（或服務成分）的特點是：至少有部分輸出是在與客戶互動的當下才完成的，無法事先完全檢驗。
blocks.en: A manufacturer produces a finished product that can be inspected and confirmed before delivery. The hallmark of a service (or a service component) is that at least part of the output is completed at the moment of interaction with the customer, so it cannot be fully inspected beforehand.

blocks.zh: 例如：CRO（合約研究組織）提供臨床試驗管理服務——你無法在「交付前」完整驗證所有服務品質，因為服務本身就是過程。
blocks.en: For example: a CRO (contract research organization) providing clinical trial management services. You cannot fully verify all service quality "before delivery", because the service itself is the process.

blocks.zh: 製藥 CDMO 的視角
blocks.en: The pharmaceutical CDMO perspective

blocks.zh: 你的公司（CDMO）同時提供「產品」（製成的藥品）和「服務」（製程開發、技術移轉、法規支援）。ISO 9001:2015 的框架更清楚地涵蓋這兩種性質，幫助 CDMO 建立更完整的 QMS。
blocks.en: Your company (a CDMO) provides both "products" (manufactured medicinal products) and "services" (process development, technology transfer, regulatory support). The ISO 9001:2015 framework covers both more clearly, helping a CDMO build a more complete QMS.

blocks.zh: 對製藥廠的實際影響
blocks.en: Practical impact on pharmaceutical plants

blocks.zh: 委外測試服務（外部實驗室）= 服務採購，納入 8.4 管控
blocks.en: Outsourced testing services (external laboratories) = purchase of services, brought under 8.4 control

blocks.zh: 委外滅菌（EO 滅菌廠）= 服務 + 製程外包，需供應商審核
blocks.en: Outsourced sterilization (EO sterilization facility) = service + process outsourcing, requiring a supplier audit

blocks.zh: CDMO 本身的製造服務 = 品質協議（Quality Agreement）是關鍵文件
blocks.en: The CDMO's own manufacturing services = the Quality Agreement is the key document

blocks.zh: Understanding Needs & Expectations of Interested Parties — 理解相關方需求
blocks.en: Understanding Needs & Expectations of Interested Parties

blocks.zh: 解讀：相關方的範圍界定
blocks.en: Commentary: Defining the Scope of Interested Parties

blocks.zh: 什麼是「相關方（Interested Parties）」？
blocks.en: What are "Interested Parties"?

blocks.zh: 對組織有影響、或受組織影響的個人或群體。在製藥 CDMO 中，典型的相關方包括：
blocks.en: Individuals or groups that affect, or are affected by, the organization. In a pharmaceutical CDMO, typical interested parties include:

blocks.zh: 客戶（品牌藥廠、仿製藥廠）
blocks.en: Customers (brand-name and generic pharmaceutical companies)

blocks.zh: 監管機構（FDA、EMA、PMDA、TFDA）
blocks.en: Regulators (FDA, EMA, PMDA, TFDA)

blocks.zh: 員工
blocks.en: Employees

blocks.zh: 原料供應商
blocks.en: Raw material suppliers

blocks.zh: 股東 / 投資人
blocks.en: Shareholders / investors

blocks.zh: 社區（環境影響、噪音等）
blocks.en: The community (environmental impact, noise and so on)

blocks.zh: 重要限制：不是所有相關方都需納入 QMS
blocks.en: Important limit: not every interested party needs to be included in the QMS

blocks.zh: 標準明確指出，組織自行判斷哪些相關方與 QMS 相關。例如：社區居民對噪音的關切，可能屬於 EMS（環境管理）範疇，而非 QMS 的範疇。不要過度擴張 QMS 的邊界，否則系統會變得臃腫且難以維護。
blocks.en: The standard states explicitly that the organization decides for itself which interested parties are relevant to the QMS. For example, residents' concerns about noise may fall within the scope of the EMS (environmental management) rather than the QMS. Do not over-expand the boundary of the QMS, or the system will become bloated and hard to maintain.

blocks.zh: 實務原則
blocks.en: Practical principle

blocks.zh: 識別相關方後，只需將「對產品/服務品質有直接影響，或對 QMS 有法規/合約要求」的需求納入管控。投資人關心的是財務回報，這不是 QMS 要處理的事——但監管機構的 cGMP 要求，絕對要納入。
blocks.en: Once the interested parties are identified, you only need to bring under control those requirements that "directly affect product/service quality, or that impose regulatory/contractual requirements on the QMS". Investors care about financial returns, which the QMS does not need to address, but regulators' cGMP requirements must absolutely be included.

blocks.zh: Risk-Based Thinking — 風險思維
blocks.en: Risk-Based Thinking

blocks.zh: 解讀：最關鍵的哲學轉變
blocks.en: Commentary: The Most Critical Philosophical Shift

blocks.zh: 核心轉變：從「有沒有程序」到「有沒有思考過風險」
blocks.en: The core shift: from "do you have a procedure?" to "have you thought about the risks?"

blocks.zh: ISO 9001:2008 有一個獨立的「預防措施（Preventive Action）」條款（8.5.3），要求組織建立預防措施程序。2015 版取消了這個條款，改為要求風險思維貫穿整個 QMS。
blocks.en: ISO 9001:2008 had a separate "Preventive Action" clause (8.5.3) requiring the organization to establish a preventive action procedure. The 2015 edition removed this clause and instead requires risk-based thinking throughout the entire QMS.

blocks.zh: 這意味著：不再是「我們有一份預防措施 SOP」就過關，而是「我們在規劃、執行每個流程時，都有系統地考慮過風險」。
blocks.en: This means it is no longer enough to say "we have a preventive action SOP"; you must be able to show that "when planning and carrying out every process, we have systematically considered the risks".

blocks.zh: 比喻：開車的風險意識 vs. 賽車的風險管理
blocks.en: Analogy: risk awareness when driving vs. risk management in racing

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 要求的是「開車時有基本的風險意識」——看到彎道減速、雨天小心。ICH Q9 要求的是「賽車手等級的系統性風險評估」——每個彎道的曲率、輪胎磨耗率、剎車距離都要量化分析。
blocks.en: What ISO 9001 requires is "basic risk awareness when driving": slowing down for a bend, taking care in the rain. ICH Q9 requires "racing-driver-level systematic risk assessment": the curvature of every bend, tyre wear rate and braking distance are all analysed quantitatively.

blocks.zh: 製藥廠同時承擔兩套要求：ISO 9001 是底線，ICH Q9 是實際要做到的高度。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical plants carry both sets of requirements: ISO 9001 is the baseline, and ICH Q9 is the height you actually have to reach.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 填充生產的實際應用
blocks.en: Practical application in CDMO filling operations

blocks.zh: 計畫階段：評估新客戶產品的複雜度風險（毒性、低劑量、高活性）→ 決定設施需求
blocks.en: Planning stage: assess the complexity risk of a new customer's product (toxicity, low dose, high potency) → determine facility requirements

blocks.zh: 製程設計：FMEA 評估無菌填充關鍵步驟（依 ICH Q9）
blocks.en: Process design: FMEA of the critical steps in aseptic filling (per ICH Q9)

blocks.zh: 供應商管理：依風險等級分類供應商，決定審核頻率
blocks.en: Supplier management: classify suppliers by risk level and decide the audit frequency

blocks.zh: 文件化：ISO 9001 不要求你把所有風險評估都保留記錄，但 FDA 的 cGMP 通常會期望看到
blocks.en: Documentation: ISO 9001 does not require you to keep records of all risk assessments, but FDA cGMP usually expects to see them

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 vs. ICH Q9 / ISO 14971 的關鍵區別
blocks.en: Key differences between ISO 9001 and ICH Q9 / ISO 14971

blocks.zh: 結論：ISO 9001 的「風險思維」是最低門檻，製藥廠實務上需依循 ICH Q9 執行更嚴格的 QRM。
blocks.en: Conclusion: the "risk-based thinking" of ISO 9001 is the minimum threshold; in practice, pharmaceutical plants must follow ICH Q9 to carry out a more rigorous QRM.

blocks.zh: Applicability — 適用性
blocks.en: Applicability

blocks.zh: 解讀：「排除」條款的廢除
blocks.en: Commentary: The Abolition of the "Exclusions" Clause

blocks.zh: 舊版「排除（Exclusions）」的問題
blocks.en: The problem with the old "Exclusions"

blocks.zh: ISO 9001:2008 允許組織宣告某些 Clause 7（Product Realization）條款「不適用」，並在品質手冊中說明理由。這在實務上被許多組織濫用——把不方便執行的條款都「排除」掉。
blocks.en: ISO 9001:2008 allowed organizations to declare certain Clause 7 (Product Realization) requirements "not applicable" and to justify this in the quality manual. In practice many organizations abused this, "excluding" every clause that was inconvenient to implement.

blocks.zh: 新版的邏輯：只有 Clause 8 可以不適用
blocks.en: The logic of the new edition: only Clause 8 requirements can be declared not applicable

blocks.zh: 2015 版改為：只有當某個 Clause 8 的要求，在你的業務範圍內根本不存在對應活動時，才能宣告不適用。條件：不適用的決定不能導致無法達到產品/服務的符合性。
blocks.en: The 2015 edition changed this: a Clause 8 requirement can be declared not applicable only when there is simply no corresponding activity within the scope of your business. Condition: the decision of non-applicability must not result in a failure to achieve conformity of products and services.

blocks.zh: 例如：一家純軟體公司，若沒有任何實體「設計與開發輸出」需要物理驗證，可宣告 8.3 的部分子條款不適用。但製藥廠幾乎不可能合理排除任何 Clause 8 要求。
blocks.en: For example: a pure software company with no physical "design and development outputs" that need physical verification may declare some sub-clauses of 8.3 not applicable. A pharmaceutical plant, however, can almost never reasonably exclude any Clause 8 requirement.

blocks.zh: 文件化資訊 · 組織知識 · 外部供應管控
blocks.en: Documented Information · Organizational Knowledge · Control of External Provision

blocks.zh: 解讀：三個新要求的製藥意涵
blocks.en: Commentary: What the Three New Requirements Mean for Pharmaceuticals

blocks.zh: A.6：「維持」vs.「保留」文件化資訊
blocks.en: A.6: "Maintain" vs. "Retain" documented information

blocks.zh: 這是 2015 版最容易混淆的術語對。理解方式：
blocks.en: This is the term pair most easily confused in the 2015 edition. The way to understand it:

blocks.zh: Maintain（維持）：持續有效的、活的文件——如 SOP、品質手冊、過程描述。對應舊版的「文件（Documents）」。
blocks.en: Maintain: continuously valid, living documents such as SOPs, the quality manual and process descriptions. Corresponds to "Documents" in the old edition.

blocks.zh: Retain（保留）：已完成的、作為證據的記錄——如批次記錄、測試報告、稽核記錄。對應舊版的「記錄（Records）」。
blocks.en: Retain: completed records kept as evidence, such as batch records, test reports and audit records. Corresponds to "Records" in the old edition.

blocks.zh: 一份文件可以同時要求「維持」（保持當前版本有效）和「保留」（歸檔舊版本）。
blocks.en: A single document can be required to be both "maintained" (keeping the current version in effect) and "retained" (archiving old versions).

blocks.zh: A.7：組織知識——製藥廠的致命弱點
blocks.en: A.7: Organizational knowledge, the Achilles heel of pharmaceutical plants

blocks.zh: 組織知識（Organizational Knowledge）是 2015 版全新的要求（無對應舊條款）。對製藥 CDMO 尤其關鍵：
blocks.en: Organizational Knowledge is an entirely new requirement in the 2015 edition (with no corresponding clause in the old edition). It is especially critical for a pharmaceutical CDMO:

blocks.zh: 資深工程師、QA 退休或離職 → 關鍵製程知識流失
blocks.en: Senior engineers or QA staff retire or leave → loss of critical process knowledge

blocks.zh: 設備供應商停止支援 → 維護知識斷鏈
blocks.en: An equipment supplier stops providing support → a break in maintenance knowledge

blocks.zh: 客戶產品技術移轉 → 知識轉移需系統化記錄
blocks.en: Technology transfer of a customer's product → knowledge transfer needs systematic records

blocks.zh: 實務工具：製程知識庫、技術移轉文件包（Technology Transfer Package）、交接 SOP、師徒制度、Lessons Learned 資料庫。
blocks.en: Practical tools: process knowledge repositories, Technology Transfer Packages, handover SOPs, mentoring programmes and Lessons Learned databases.

blocks.zh: 三個 A 條款的共同主題
blocks.en: The common theme of the three A clauses

blocks.zh: A.6（文件彈性化）、A.7（知識管理）、A.8（供應風險管控）都體現了 2015 版的核心精神：減少強制規定，增加組織自主判斷的空間——但要求你有能力說明判斷的依據。這對成熟的製藥 QMS 是鬆綁，對薄弱的 QMS 卻是更大的挑戰。
blocks.en: A.6 (flexible documentation), A.7 (knowledge management) and A.8 (control of supply risk) all reflect the core spirit of the 2015 edition: fewer prescriptive rules and more room for the organization's own judgement, but you must be able to explain the basis for that judgement. For a mature pharmaceutical QMS this is a relaxation; for a weak QMS it is a bigger challenge.

blocks.zh: A.8：外部供應的風險分級管控
blocks.en: A.8: Risk-graded control of external provision

blocks.zh: ISO 9001:2015 明確要求以風險思維決定對外部供應商的管控強度，而非一刀切。典型的分級方式：
blocks.en: ISO 9001:2015 explicitly requires that the intensity of control over external providers be decided using risk-based thinking, rather than one size fits all. A typical grading approach:

blocks.zh: 附錄B（資訊性）— ISO/TC 176 品質管理支援標準生態圈
blocks.en: Annex B (Informative): The ISO/TC 176 Ecosystem of Quality Management Supporting Standards

blocks.zh: 解讀：ISO/TC 176 標準生態圈
blocks.en: Commentary: The ISO/TC 176 Standards Ecosystem

blocks.zh: ISO/TC 176 是誰？
blocks.en: Who is ISO/TC 176?

blocks.zh: ISO Technical Committee 176（品質管理與品質保證技術委員會），負責制訂所有 ISO 9000 系列及相關配套標準。本附錄列出的所有標準都是同一個委員會的產品，相互一致、互相補強。
blocks.en: ISO Technical Committee 176 (Quality management and quality assurance) is responsible for developing the entire ISO 9000 family and related companion standards. All the standards listed in this annex are products of the same committee, consistent with and complementing one another.

blocks.zh: 製藥廠最常用的配套標準
blocks.en: The companion standards most used by pharmaceutical plants

blocks.zh: ISO 10012 — 量測管理系統：與 21 CFR Part 11 校正要求、計量可追溯性高度相關。量測設備管控是製藥 QMS 的核心，這份標準提供了實作指引。
blocks.en: ISO 10012: measurement management systems. Closely related to the calibration requirements of 21 CFR Part 11 and to metrological traceability. Control of measuring equipment is central to a pharmaceutical QMS, and this standard provides implementation guidance.

blocks.zh: ISO/TR 10013 — QMS 文件化指引：協助設計 SOP 體系、文件架構，對文件管理系統建置很有幫助。
blocks.en: ISO/TR 10013: guidelines for QMS documentation. Helps design the SOP system and document architecture, and is very useful for building a document management system.

blocks.zh: ISO 10015 — 培訓指引：GMP 培訓體系設計、培訓有效性評估，對應 ISO 9001 Clause 7.2（能力）。
blocks.en: ISO 10015: guidelines for training. Design of a GMP training system and evaluation of training effectiveness, corresponding to ISO 9001 Clause 7.2 (Competence).

blocks.zh: ISO 19011 — 稽核管理：內部稽核計畫設計、稽核員能力評估，是 ISO 9001 Clause 9.2 的最佳實踐指引。
blocks.en: ISO 19011: guidelines for auditing management systems. Design of the internal audit programme and evaluation of auditor competence; the best-practice guide for ISO 9001 Clause 9.2.

blocks.zh: 比喻：ISO 9001 是作業系統，配套標準是 App
blocks.en: Analogy: ISO 9001 is the operating system; the companion standards are apps

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 定義了 QMS 的「作業系統」——它說你需要「管理量測設備」（7.1.5），但不告訴你怎麼設計校正程序。ISO 10012 就是那個「App」，告訴你量測管理系統的具體做法。根據你的業務需求，選擇性安裝對你有用的 App 即可。
blocks.en: ISO 9001 defines the "operating system" of a QMS: it says you need to "manage measuring equipment" (7.1.5) but does not tell you how to design a calibration procedure. ISO 10012 is the "app" that tells you the specific way to run a measurement management system. Depending on your business needs, install only the apps that are useful to you.

blocks.zh: Table B.1 的閱讀邏輯
blocks.en: The reading logic of Table B.1

blocks.zh: 橫軸是 ISO 9001:2015 的條款（Clause 4-10），縱軸是支援標準。找到你正在建立的系統要素（如供應商管控 → Cl.8），往上查表，找到相關的支援標準（如 ISO 10019 供應商評估）。這是快速定位配套資源的工具。
blocks.en: The horizontal axis is the clauses of ISO 9001:2015 (Clauses 4-10) and the vertical axis is the supporting standards. Find the system element you are building (e.g. supplier control → Cl.8), look up the table, and find the related supporting standard (e.g. ISO 10019, supplier evaluation). It is a tool for quickly locating companion resources.

blocks.zh: 比較
blocks.en: Comparison

blocks.zh: 三大 QMS 標準定位對比——製藥包材產業必備視角
blocks.en: Positioning of the Three Major QMS Standards: A Must-Have Perspective for the Pharmaceutical Packaging Industry

blocks.zh: 為什麼要比較這三個標準？
blocks.en: Why compare these three standards?

blocks.zh: ISO 15378（初級包材 GMP 品質管理系統）是以 ISO 9001 為基礎、加上 GMP 層疊加的專業標準。了解三者的定位差異，有助於製藥 CDMO 判斷：在哪些場景使用哪個標準框架，以及多標準整合的策略。
blocks.en: ISO 15378 (GMP quality management systems for primary packaging materials for medicinal products) is a specialist standard based on ISO 9001 with a GMP layer added. Understanding how the three are positioned helps a pharmaceutical CDMO decide which standard framework to use in which situations, and how to integrate multiple standards.

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 vs. ISO 9001：為什麼沒有以 2015 版為基礎？
blocks.en: ISO 13485 vs. ISO 9001: why is it not based on the 2015 edition?

blocks.zh: ISO 13485:2016 仍以 ISO 9001:2008 為框架基礎，而非 2015 版。原因：醫療器材產業的監管機構（FDA、BSI 等）認為 ISO 9001:2015 的彈性化方向（移除強制性持續改善、取消品質手冊要求）對高風險的醫療器材行業不合適。因此 ISO 13485 維持更嚴格的強制要求，並可能在未來版本才考慮融合 HLS 架構。
blocks.en: ISO 13485:2016 is still built on the framework of ISO 9001:2008, not the 2015 edition. The reason: regulators in the medical device industry (FDA, BSI and others) consider the flexible direction of ISO 9001:2015 (removing the mandatory continual improvement requirement and the quality manual requirement) unsuitable for the high-risk medical device sector. ISO 13485 therefore retains the stricter mandatory requirements, and may consider aligning with the HLS structure only in a future edition.

blocks.zh: 三標準整合策略
blocks.en: Strategy for integrating the three standards

blocks.zh: 對於同時涉及多個領域的製造商（如：既做初級包材也供應醫療器材），整合三個標準的關鍵是：
blocks.en: For manufacturers working across several fields (for example, making both primary packaging materials and supplying medical devices), the keys to integrating the three standards are:

blocks.zh: 以 ISO 9001 的 HLS 架構為骨幹
blocks.en: Use the HLS structure of ISO 9001 as the backbone

blocks.zh: 在適用範圍內疊加 ISO 13485 的強制要求
blocks.en: Layer on the mandatory requirements of ISO 13485 within the applicable scope

blocks.zh: 在包材業務範圍內疊加 ISO 15378 的 GMP 層
blocks.en: Layer on the GMP requirements of ISO 15378 within the scope of the packaging business

blocks.zh: 避免為不同客戶群維護三套獨立文件體系——盡量整合
blocks.en: Avoid maintaining three separate documentation systems for different customer groups: integrate as far as possible

blocks.zh: Bibliography — 參考書目
blocks.en: Bibliography

blocks.zh: 延伸閱讀與相關標準清單
blocks.en: Further Reading and List of Related Standards

blocks.zh: 解讀：參考書目導讀
blocks.en: Commentary: A Guide to the Bibliography

blocks.zh: 製藥 QMS 建置的推薦閱讀順序
blocks.en: Recommended reading order for building a pharmaceutical QMS

blocks.zh: 如果你是製藥廠 QA，從這份書目中，建議的優先順序：
blocks.en: If you are in pharmaceutical QA, the recommended priority order from this bibliography is:

blocks.zh: ISO 9000（雖不在書目中，但是基礎）— 先建立術語概念
blocks.en: ISO 9000 (not in the bibliography, but foundational): first build the terminology and concepts

blocks.zh: ISO 9004（[1]）— 了解更成熟的 QMS 樣貌，適合系統優化階段
blocks.en: ISO 9004 ([1]): see what a more mature QMS looks like; suited to the system optimization stage

blocks.zh: ISO 19011（[18]）— 建立內部稽核能力的實用指引
blocks.en: ISO 19011 ([18]): practical guidance for building internal audit capability

blocks.zh: ISO 10012（[10]）— 量測管理，GMP 校正系統的補充
blocks.en: ISO 10012 ([10]): measurement management, a supplement to the GMP calibration system

blocks.zh: ISO 10015（[13]）— GMP 培訓體系設計
blocks.en: ISO 10015 ([13]): design of a GMP training system

blocks.zh: ISO 31000（[19]）— 若要建立正式風險管理框架
blocks.en: ISO 31000 ([19]): if you want to build a formal risk management framework

blocks.zh: ISO 31000 — 正式風險管理的框架
blocks.en: ISO 31000: a framework for formal risk management

blocks.zh: 雖然 ISO 9001 本身不要求正式風險管理方法論，但附錄書目中列入了 ISO 31000（風險管理原則與指引）。這代表 ISO 9001 認可：有需要的組織可以採用 ISO 31000 作為建立更完整風險管理系統的基礎。
blocks.en: Although ISO 9001 itself does not require a formal risk management methodology, the annex bibliography includes ISO 31000 (risk management principles and guidelines). This signals that ISO 9001 recognizes that organizations that need to can adopt ISO 31000 as the basis for building a more complete risk management system.

blocks.zh: 在製藥業，ISO 31000 + ICH Q9 + 具體的 FMEA 工具，構成了完整的 QRM 體系。
blocks.en: In the pharmaceutical industry, ISO 31000 + ICH Q9 + specific FMEA tools make up a complete QRM system.

blocks.zh: 書目最後兩個網址之一是 ISO 9001 稽核實踐小組（APG）的網站。這個小組由 ISO/TC 176 和 IAF（國際認可論壇）共同運作，提供免費的稽核技術文件和常見問題解答——是準備 ISO 9001 認證稽核的寶貴免費資源。
blocks.en: One of the last two URLs in the bibliography is the website of the ISO 9001 Auditing Practices Group (APG). This group is run jointly by ISO/TC 176 and the IAF (International Accreditation Forum) and provides free audit technical documents and answers to frequently asked questions, a valuable free resource for preparing for an ISO 9001 certification audit.

blocks.zh: 思考練習：你的 CDMO 需要哪些配套標準？
blocks.en: Reflection exercise: which companion standards does your CDMO need?

blocks.zh: 基於你在無菌填充 CDMO 的工作，哪三個 ISO/TC 176 支援標準最值得深入研讀？試著根據你的實際業務挑戰，連結到 Table B.1 中的對應條款，說明選擇的理由。
blocks.en: Based on your work in an aseptic filling CDMO, which three ISO/TC 176 supporting standards are most worth studying in depth? Try to link your actual business challenges to the corresponding clauses in Table B.1 and explain the reasons for your choices.

blocks.zh: 提示：量測校正體系、供應商稽核、GMP 培訓記錄——各對應哪個支援標準？
blocks.en: Hint: measurement and calibration system, supplier audits, GMP training records: which supporting standard does each correspond to?

blocks.zh: 總結
blocks.en: Summary

blocks.zh: Section Summary — 本節重點總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: ISO 9001:2015 Annex A & B 核心要點回顧
blocks.en: Key Points Review of ISO 9001:2015 Annex A & B

blocks.zh: A.1 術語變革：不強制組織改變內部術語，但需理解術語映射（尤其 documented information 的 maintain vs. retain 區別）
blocks.en: A.1 Terminology changes: organizations are not forced to change their internal terminology, but need to understand the terminology mapping (especially the maintain vs. retain distinction for documented information)

blocks.zh: A.2 產品與服務：服務的「現場性」要求前置品質管控，無法事後完全檢驗
blocks.en: A.2 Products and services: the "real-time" nature of services requires upfront quality control, because they cannot be fully inspected afterwards

blocks.zh: A.3 相關方：組織自主判斷哪些相關方與 QMS 相關，不需無限擴張範圍
blocks.en: A.3 Interested parties: the organization decides for itself which interested parties are relevant to the QMS and need not expand the scope indefinitely

blocks.zh: A.4 風險思維：取代獨立的預防措施條款；ISO 9001 不要求正式風險管理方法論（與 ICH Q9 / ISO 14971 形成重要對比）
blocks.en: A.4 Risk-based thinking: replaces the separate preventive action clause; ISO 9001 does not require a formal risk management methodology (an important contrast with ICH Q9 / ISO 14971)

blocks.zh: A.5 適用性：「排除」一詞廢除；只有 Clause 8 可宣告不適用，且不能影響產品符合性
blocks.en: A.5 Applicability: the term "exclusions" is abolished; only Clause 8 requirements can be declared not applicable, and this must not affect product conformity

blocks.zh: A.6 文件化資訊：maintain（維持活文件）vs. retain（保留記錄）是核心概念
blocks.en: A.6 Documented information: maintain (living documents) vs. retain (records) is the core concept

blocks.zh: A.7 組織知識：2015 版新增要求，保護關鍵製程知識不因人員流失而消失
blocks.en: A.7 Organizational knowledge: a new requirement in the 2015 edition, protecting critical process knowledge from being lost with staff turnover

blocks.zh: A.8 外部供應管控：以風險為基礎決定管控強度，涵蓋採購、合作、外包三種形式
blocks.en: A.8 Control of external provision: control intensity is decided on a risk basis, covering three forms: purchasing, partnering and outsourcing

blocks.zh: Annex B 核心訊息
blocks.en: Key messages of Annex B

blocks.zh: ISO/TC 176 維護一個完整的支援標準生態系，ISO 9001 是核心，其他標準提供具體實踐指引
blocks.en: ISO/TC 176 maintains a complete ecosystem of supporting standards: ISO 9001 is the core, and the other standards provide specific implementation guidance

blocks.zh: Table B.1 是快速定位配套資源的導覽工具
blocks.en: Table B.1 is a navigation tool for quickly locating companion resources

blocks.zh: 本附錄不包含各行業的專業 QMS 標準（如 ISO 13485、ISO 15378）——這些不在 TC 176 的直接管轄下
blocks.en: This annex does not include industry-specific QMS standards (such as ISO 13485 and ISO 15378), which do not fall directly under TC 176's remit

blocks.zh: 三標準比較的核心結論
blocks.en: Core conclusions of the three-standard comparison

blocks.zh: ISO 9001：彈性、風險思維驅動、適合任何組織的通用框架
blocks.en: ISO 9001: flexible, driven by risk-based thinking, a general framework suitable for any organization

blocks.zh: ISO 13485：更嚴格、持續改善非強制、ISO 14971 風險管理為強制要求、醫療器材導向
blocks.en: ISO 13485: stricter, continual improvement not mandatory, ISO 14971 risk management mandatory, medical-device oriented

blocks.zh: ISO 15378：ISO 9001 + GMP 疊加、填充用初級包材專用、製藥客戶最直接相關
blocks.en: ISO 15378: ISO 9001 + GMP layer, specific to primary packaging materials for filling, most directly relevant to pharmaceutical customers

blocks.zh: 最後的思維框架
blocks.en: A final thinking framework

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 的 Annex A 最核心的訊息是：2015 版從「合規導向」轉向「績效導向」。不再問「你有沒有這個程序？」，而是問「你有沒有識別風險並採取有效行動？」。這正是 ICH Q10 的精神——一個活的、有效的品質系統，而非一堆漂亮的文件。
blocks.en: The core message of ISO 9001 Annex A is: the 2015 edition shifts from "compliance orientation" to "performance orientation". The question is no longer "do you have this procedure?" but "have you identified the risks and taken effective action?" This is exactly the spirit of ICH Q10: a living, effective quality system, rather than a pile of beautiful documents.
